compute_stack_amplitudes_interior: compute wave amplitudes at interior layers within a multilayer stack using scattering matrices
colocate_amplitudes_at_z_offset: compute forward and backward propagating wave amplitudes at a given z offset inside a layer
compute_fields_from_wave_amplitudes: compute electric and magnetic field Fourier coefficients from forward and backward wave amplitudes
evaluate_poynting_flux_from_amplitudes: compute the total forward and backward Poynting flux from wave amplitudes and layer solve results
compute_3d_fields_on_grid: compute three-dimensional electric and magnetic fields across a stack of layers on a real-space grid
